about.title: About
about.subtitle: My Story
about.intro: I am a certified Art Therapy Practitioner and Life Coach dedicated to helping individuals reconnect with themselves through creative and mindful practices.
about.body: With a diploma in Art Therapy and years of experience in coaching and wellness, I blend evidence-based techniques with creative expression to guide clients toward meaningful transformation. My approach honors each person's unique journey — whether you are navigating a transition, seeking clarity, or simply wanting to grow.
about.philosophyText: I believe that healing and growth are deeply personal. My role is to hold space, ask the right questions, and provide tools that empower you to write your own story.

coaching.title: 1:1 Coaching
coaching.description: Personalized one-on-one sessions focused on your goals, challenges, and vision. Together, we create an action plan aligned with your values and strengths.

artTherapy.title: Art Therapy Sessions
artTherapy.description: Using creative modalities as a therapeutic tool, these sessions help you express, explore, and process emotions that may be difficult to articulate through words alone.

wellness.title: Wellness Programs
wellness.description: Structured programs combining mindfulness, self-awareness practices, and personal growth frameworks to support your overall wellbeing and life balance.

videos.title: Content Hub
videos.subtitle: Free Educational Resources
videos.intro: Explore a curated collection of videos on art therapy, coaching techniques, mindfulness practices, and personal growth. Content is organized into structured playlists for a focused learning experience.

cta.title: Ready to Begin Your Journey?
cta.subtitle: Take the first step toward clarity, healing, and growth. A single session can open a new perspective.
